type.description: Kind of update; always READING_RECORDED for this data

reading_uid.description: Client-generated identifier of the batch, unique across the platform

equipment_id.description: Identifier of the unit the batch was taken on

device_id.description: Identifier of the device that produced the batch

humidity.description: Average relative humidity, as a percentage

sample_count.description: Number of raw samples folded into the batch

recorded_at.description: Format: date-time (ISO 8601 UTC with Z, e.g. 2026-09-29T08:30:00Z) When the batch was taken, by the device clock

received_at.description: Format: date-time (ISO 8601 UTC with Z, e.g. 2026-09-29T08:30:00Z) When the platform received the batch

under_maintenance.description: Whether a maintenance window covered recorded_at
